title: Set up your bookings
summary: Your hours, how many customers at once, gaps between bookings and how far ahead people can book.

steps.title: Open Booking settings
steps.body: Tap Calendar, then Settings. Or on a phone tap More, then Booking settings. You can pause bookings here any time; your page then asks people to message you instead.

steps.title: Your opening hours
steps.body: Set the days and times customers can book. Close a day by switching it off.

steps.title: Customers at the same time
steps.body: If you or your team can do two customers at once, say 2. Tikka only shows a time while there's room.

steps.title: Time between bookings
steps.body: Keep a few minutes free after each booking to clean up or rest, and extra after a home visit to travel. A service can have its own gap.

steps.title: How soon and how far ahead
steps.body: The latest someone can book, like 2 hours before, and how far ahead they can book. Brides book months ahead: 6 months works well for weddings.

steps.title: Deposit, rules and questions
steps.body: Choose your deposit (see "Take deposits on bookings"), the booking rules customers see before they pay, and up to 3 questions for any service, like "What length?" or "Is it your first time?".
